request.style: English, children's song, bright children's choir with cheerful male lead, ukulele, glockenspiel, toy trumpet, hand claps, marching snare, bouncy bass, sing-along, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Gideon was hiding, threshing wheat where none could see
Scared of all the Midianites, like locusts on the trees
Then an angel sat beneath the oak and said to him
The LORD is with you, mighty warrior
Who, me? said Gideon, I am the least of all
But God said, I will be with you, and God is never small

[Chorus]
Blow your trumpet, toot toot toot
Smash your jar, crash crash crash
Hold your torch up shining bright
A sword for the LORD and for Gideon
God can win with just a few
When we trust him, me and you

[Verse]
Gideon was nervous, so he laid a woolly fleece
On the threshing floor at night and said, God, show me please
In the morning, wet fleece, and the ground was dry all round
Next night, dry fleece, and dew on all the ground

[Verse]
Thirty-two thousand soldiers came to stand at Gideon's side
Too many, said the LORD, or they will boast in pride
Down to ten thousand, then down to the stream they went
Three hundred lapped the water, and those were the ones God sent

[Chorus]
Blow your trumpet, toot toot toot
Smash your jar, crash crash crash
Hold your torch up shining bright
A sword for the LORD and for Gideon
God can win with just a few
When we trust him, me and you

[Bridge]
One hundred, two hundred, three hundred men
All around the camp in the dark night
Ready, steady, blow, smash, shine
And the LORD made it right
